title: TapeDeck
wordCountMethod: Whitespace-delimited words in scenes[].narration only; titles, captions, disclosures, and notes are not spoken.
timingConvention: start and end are seconds; start is inclusive, end is exclusive; cuts are contiguous.

captureIndex.note: Current recorded capture index; raw references remain available per scene. docs/demo-evidence.json stays historical.

allocationNote: Rubric weights are judging weights, not mandatory runtime percentages. Primary criteria count each second once; secondary mappings carry no additional time.

production.format: Actual captured terminal output, edited for time; no simulated product UI.
production.disclosure: Actual terminal captures · edited for time · synthetic system narration
production.disclosurePlacement: Show the full disclosure at the opening and in the video description; retain the short label throughout. These are unspoken production overlays, not terminal output.
production.captureStatus: Fresh Qwen experiment captured September 26, 2026 at 19:51 UTC; earlier Atlas download rechecked/reopened offline at 19:52 UTC. The 19:54 UTC capture index also verifies the current Qwen image. JSON evidence inspected; no video rendered here.
production.narrationVoice: macOS Samantha system voice; not a cloned person

atlasRetry.reason: Network timeouts on all replica servers, per user update on September 26, 2026.

editingRules: Use genuine terminal captures; retain source/run IDs and result lines. Trim waits, not outcomes.
Hold the replay result, MongoDB collections/publication boundary, and offline reopen/hash result legibly. Do not replace proof with title cards.
Architecture captions explain checked source and the saved manifest; they are not a live Atlas query or a fabricated cloud console.
Use fresh Qwen counts 4/0/3/4; historical docs/demo-evidence.json records a different 4/0/3/6 experiment and must not supply the current video labels.
Use actual recorded-run events and report inspection. A formatted projection of JSON is derived evidence, not raw process stdout or a separately executed replay command.
Show only actual results from the fresh replay/reopen capture. Do not prepopulate a terminal transcript with expected output.
If a new capture fails, retain its failure or label the earlier saved verification with its timestamp; do not imply fresh success.
Redact credentials; do not alter counts, hashes, verdicts, errors, or snapshot identity. No cost-savings, ROI, world-first, or model-ranking claims.

qwenLocal.label: Qwen · local only
qwenLocal.identityNote: The current Qwen image has its own verified identity and 77 checked payloads. It remains local and is not the prior Atlas snapshot.

scenes.title: Save the experiment
scenes.narration: A failed agent run needs more than chat logs. TapeDeck saves reopenable, executable experiments.

criterionMapping.rationale: Lead with the developer's failure-recovery pain, then frame the experiment as executable and reopenable rather than another chat transcript; do not claim a world first.

capture.direction: Open on the actual sum-function patch or saved-image evidence in a terminal. Frame failed-agent recovery as the use case, not a fabricated failure of the passing demo. Add the short title, MongoDB/Pharo label, and production disclosure as editorial overlays, not fake application chrome.

scenes.title: Replay: zero calls
scenes.narration: Real local Qwen on a coding task: baseline, four calls; replay, zero; fork, three; fresh run, four. Independently counted. All live verifiers passed. Replay returns recorded behavior, not a new verdict.

criterionMapping.rationale: Actual strict replay terminal output plus independently measured baseline/replay/fork/fresh results; no new replay verifier verdict.

capture.direction: Spend roughly 10 seconds on actual captured comparison/replay completion and a readable inspection of its replay result, including a long result hold. Use the remaining 4 seconds for the fresh 4/0/3/4 summary. The captured command is local-demo; do not relabel it as a standalone replay invocation.
mustShow: Replay has no new verifier verdict
capture.guardrail: Raw local-demo stdout shows replayVerified and live outcomes; detailed counts/IDs come from its results and gateway log. Label any formatted projection as recorded evidence rather than inventing stdout.

scenes.title: Fork at divergence
scenes.narration: We intercept requests, record tool outcomes, and checkpoint Git. Divergence stops replay; an explicit fork restores the checkpoint before continuing live.

criterionMapping.rationale: Show the provider interception and replay state machine, not generic agent terminology: matched recorded tools, Git restore point, and an explicit live boundary.

capture.direction: Use about 4 seconds for actual read/edit/bash tool calls and the sum-function patch, with brief source context for interception; use 6 seconds for the fresh fork report, real restoredSnapshot hash, and action: live. Do not imply the fork is running during playback.
capture.guardrail: This fork explicitly permits the changed system prompt; it is not a strict replay under an identical harness.

scenes.title: MongoDB stores it
scenes.narration: MongoDB GridFS stores checksummed images and their companions in file and chunk collections. Our manifest collection publishes a snapshot only after every upload succeeds.

criterionMapping.rationale: Make MongoDB concrete: GridFS metadata/chunks, a separate manifest collection, streamed SHA-256/size checks, and publish-after-upload ordering.

symbols: corrupt, truncated, oversized, or missing GridFS files

capture.direction: Spend the full 10 seconds on actual terminal inspection of the prior downloaded manifest and relevant MongoDB source excerpts. Explain the collection roles with large, short overlays; no Atlas browser, live query, upload animation, or invented chunk-count output.
capture.guardrail: Use the prior snapshot's configured agent_snapshots bucket, not the code's default bucket name. This is source-backed architecture plus saved cloud evidence, not current cloud connectivity.

scenes.title: Reopen the download
scenes.narration: Pharo preserves objects and files. This earlier Atlas download reopens with four companion hashes verified. Today’s Qwen image is local; its upload remains blocked.

criterionMapping.rationale: Actual offline hash/reopen proof of a downloaded executable image, with Pharo object and embedded-file persistence; preserve separate snapshot identities.

capture.direction: Use roughly 4 seconds for the actual rechecked companion hashes and 8 seconds for the captured reopen command/result and restored counts. Hold the recorded 491 file plus 6 bundle checksum result. Keep the Qwen local-only comparison visible as an explicitly separate caption.
mustShow: Four companion hashes checked against saved manifest
capture.guardrail: The archive companion hash covers the published archive bytes (canonical JSON), not arbitrary archive formatting. This fresh offline recheck is not a new upload or download. Do not attach the prior Atlas hashes to either Qwen experiment.

scenes.title: Debug without rerunning
scenes.narration: Recover, review, and debug failures without repeating inference during replay. Bring one failing run; test a live alternative.

criterionMapping.rationale: Target developers investigating agent failures: preserve and inspect what happened before paying the compute cost of a deliberate live alternative. No invented ROI.

capture.direction: Hold the actual restored-image or replay result beneath the closing ask. Do not invent a failed run: the measured baseline, fork, and fresh run passed; failure investigation is the use case.
